sentence: At 1,000,000 CNY the ETF book is open (one lot 14,902.37 CNY, 67.1x the floor) while the carry book prints 0 executable lot(s) and needs 1,159,599 CNY to open its cheapest leg (short 159,599 = 15.96%). Today's ETF capacity line sits at 4,934,482 CNY (reading 0.2027% of ADV against a 1.00% line), so this capital fits with 3,934,482 CNY of headroom on the best day of the last 60 sessions. Opening both at once needs 6,094,080 CNY on the best capacity day (5,482,893 on the median day).
caveats: The ETF capacity reading is a 60-session ladder of 20-day median ADV, not an order-book measurement: it says how often this capital fits, not how much it costs to push.
etf_book_ticket_floor is a whole-lot arithmetic face and its cutoff can lag the capacity face; every face's own cutoff is printed in face_cutoffs.
The carry book's funding rung comes from the adopted 8% hard cap; the un-adopted road (lower target to 8.9958%/9.2208%) is printed on that face and is not applied here.
